contents: api_proxy_client: '' # name of the chiliz_service_clients_bundle.api_proxy_clients to use
ttl: 300 # ttl for cache of configuration-service values (default to 300)
"<your-configuration-code>": # The key here will be the code of the configuration in configuration-service (the key to get it)
description: "" # Put a description in here to explain in backoffice what this configuration is used for
type: "" # The type of values for this configuration (text, boolean, integer, json, date, datetime or url)
defaultValue: "" # The default value of the configuration (fallback if it does not exist on configuration-service or if configuration-service is down)
# Define what scopes should be associated with this configuration.
# * "yes": will add both current %service_name% and frontend scopes;
# * "no": default value, will add current %service_name% but not frontend scope;
# * "only": will only add frontend scope, meaning it will not be usable by this backend-service;
